heading.en: Alma teaches the poor whose afflictions had humbled them—Faith is a hope in that which is not seen which is true—Alma testifies that angels minister to men, women, and children—Alma compares the word unto a seed—It must be planted and nourished—Then it grows into a tree from which the fruit of eternal life is picked. About 74 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua a'oa'o atu Alema i e matitiva o e na faalotomaualalaloina e o latou puapuaga—O le faatuatua o le faamoemoe lea i mea e le vaaia a ua moni—Ua molimau atu Alema e auauna mai agelu i tane, fafine, ma tamaiti—Ua faatusa e Alema le afioga i se fatu—E ao ina totō ma tausia—Ona tupu lea ma avea ma laau e tau mai ai le fua o le ola e faavavau. E tusa o le 74 T.L.M.

words.en: in that which is not seen
